system.description:
A sensor limb up to three meters long that can thin to the width of a pencil, fitted with pict-capture devices. It gives +2k0 on all Perception tests, can examine surfaces microscopically and works as a telescopic sight.

Its infrared torch and sensors remove all darkness penalties, and it carries a light that can be tinted many colors. Only tech-priests can use mechadendrites, up to a number equal to their Constitution.
system.effectText: +2k0 Perception tests, microscope/telescopic sight, no darkness penalties, coloured light.
